description: nanoMuse: a fully open-source, Muse-style personal agent for every device you own. One agent with a name and a face that does things, keeps working while the app is closed, remembers you, and asks before anything you cannot undo. On your Android phone today, with your own model; the phone's screen as a hand, and your PC driven from the phone.
